decisions.basis: A submission list cannot shrink the denominator.
decisions.choice: Carry the exact independently generated required set and one explicit result/gate row for every required item, including missing evidence.

decisions.basis: Labels, paths and checksums without actual resolved data are not a proof.
decisions.choice: Bind actual native result data to captured artifact bytes, with explicit snapshot, interpretation, dependency, theory, assumptions, profile and runtime references.

decisions.basis: Schema/correspondence success cannot self-grant readiness or source-owner acceptance.
decisions.choice: Keep candidate bundles at not-assessed readiness; independent verification produces its own later report.

decisions.basis: The two existing controlled vocabularies differ; mapping labels must not change proposition strength.
decisions.choice: Use an explicit finite-native to A01 vocabulary bridge: bounded-exhaustion to finite-exhaustion, preserving the exact finite scope and no strength promotion.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Unknown, unsupported, stale and missing evidence cannot aggregate to ready; actual result data and all required statements are present; schema-only validation never labeled proof.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Bind sources, interpretation, dependencies, required statements, profile, tool versions, assumptions, native inputs/results and review statuses; keep execution/currentness/fidelity/verdict/strength/readiness separate.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Unknown, unsupported, stale and missing evidence cannot aggregate to ready; actual result data and all required statements are present; schema-only validation never labeled proof.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
